average_household_size.definition: Average number of people per occupied housing unit.
average_household_size.label: Average household size

median_age.definition: Age that divides the population into two numerically equal groups.
median_age.label: Median age

median_household_income.definition: Median household income in inflation-adjusted dollars for the ACS period's final year.
median_household_income.label: Median household income

multifamily_share.definition: Share of housing units located in structures containing five or more units.
multifamily_share.label: Housing in 5+-unit structures

rent_burden_share.definition: Share of renter households with gross rent equal to at least 30 percent of household income, excluding records where burden is not computed.
rent_burden_share.label: Rent-burdened households
rent_burden_share.universe: Renter-occupied units paying cash rent with burden computed

renter_share.definition: Share of occupied housing units that are renter occupied.
renter_share.label: Renter-occupied share
